assessment.title: Fictional formative systems exercise
assessment.prompt: Explain why a queue consumer should handle duplicate delivery and name one mitigation.

levels.description: No relevant cause or an incorrect claim
Mentions retry without connecting it to acknowledgement
Connects retry after a lost acknowledgement to duplicate delivery
Uses an idempotency key or stored processed message IDs

submissions.text: A lost acknowledgement can trigger a retry and deliver the same message again. Store processed message IDs to ignore repeats.
The queue may retry. Use a faster computer.

suggestions.reason: The explanation connects retry to lost acknowledgement, which is a correct cause of duplicate delivery.

suggestions.quote: Store processed message IDs to ignore repeats.
suggestions.reason: The mitigation uses an idempotency key or stored processed message IDs, which is a valid and effective mitigation for duplicate delivery.
